svg.title: Forest-carbon reassessment: author’s original 26.15–32.60 percent benchmark and unresolved current allocation
svg.desc: Conceptual forest-carbon remeasurement with paired emission and removal corrections. No historical percentage is encoded in the forest ribbon. Conditional 2010 arithmetic appears in the separate plate inset. The original topology and palette are preserved; widths are schematic. Hatched and outlined green denotes unresolved magnitude, not a quantitative source volume.
svg.text: Oil and gas extraction and refining
Conceptual operators, not EDGAR subtotals • widths are not measured shares
